text:
Evan Brooks: Heads-up — Orion Models wants us to onboard orion-7b-open to the Marketplace and enable an SI package with CloudForge + an optional on-prem bundle. They asked for a firm launch window in 3 weeks. Need clarity on distribution rights for quantized derivatives.

Laila Hassan: Quick ask to Orion: please confirm exact license (SPDX) and whether theres a clause prohibiting redistribution of converted artifacts.

Omar Singh: For eng-ml: if they provide only fp16, we can produce q4_0/q8_0 variants but need explicit permission to distribute those to customers and SI partners.

Priya Das: Marketing note: partner wants a co-branded blog + joint webinar. Well need logos, a short partner quote, and embargo availability 5 days before the announce.

legal-bot: Auto-scan result: model-card references CC-BY data subsets. Recommend "Derived Artifacts Redistribution" clause and a provenance requirement: artifacts must include provenance.json and signature.

Evan Brooks: Proposed flow: 1) license check (Legal, 48h), 2) artifact ingest + smoke tests (Eng-Platform, 48h), 3) quant/eval (Eng-ML, 2 days), 4) SI validation (CloudForge, 3-5 days), 5) 7-day embargo then announce. Can we hit 3 weeks if license OK?

Laila Hassan: Probably — but geofencing ask from CloudForge: some enterprise customers require EU-only hosting. Need geoblocking addendum and KMS notes for Private SKUs.

Omar Singh: Tech checklist I'll need from Orion:
- model_id: orion-7b-open
- weights: fp16 @ sha256
- tokenizer & config
- optional: q4_0 artifacts
- sample inputs + perf report
If they don't provide q artifacts, Eng-ML will convert but must be allowed to publish q variants.

Priya Das: Sales/Partner ops: please confirm co-sell splits and whether Orion will support partner-led demos. That affects webinar scheduling.

Evan Brooks: Action items: Laila -> request SPDX and license carveouts (today). Omar -> draft minimal ingest checklist (today). Priya -> partner comms + requested marketing assets list. Legal-bot -> surface precedent addenda. Reconvene tomorrow 9am PT.

Laila Hassan: On it. I'll ping Orion counsel and post updates here.

Omar Singh: I'll post the ingest template link in this thread when ready.

Priya Das: I'll prepare a draft co-announcement timeline and share.

legal-bot: Found two precedent addenda: "Derived Artifacts & Geofencing v2" and "Marketplace Hosting Addendum". Sending links to drive.

Evan Brooks: Thanks all — keep this tight so we can meet partner window. Flag blockers here immediately.
